```{=html}
<style>
.w056 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.9rem; }
.w056 .w056-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w056 .w056-q { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.w056 .w056-label { font-weight: 600; }
.w056 .w056-in {
  max-width: 260px; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.9rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
}
.w056 .w056-in.w056-right { border-color: #2e7d32; }
.w056 .w056-in.w056-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w056 .w056-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w056 .w056-controls button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w056 .w056-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w056 .w056-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w056 .w056-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w056 .w056-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
</style>
<div class="w056 iw" id="w056">
  <div class="w056-list"></div>
  <div class="w056-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w056-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w056-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w056-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w056-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w056-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w056');
  const list = root.querySelector('.w056-list');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w056-msg');
  const QS = [
    {
      q: '1. The dominant orchestration system, which schedules containers onto worker nodes and drives the running system toward a declared desired state:',
      accept: ['kubernetes', 'k8s'],
      canon: 'Kubernetes'
    },
    {
      q: '2. Kubernetes groups containers into … (one word):',
      accept: ['pods', 'pod'],
      canon: 'pods'
    },
    {
      q: '3. The part of Kubernetes that continuously compares reality with the declared state — a management plane, and therefore a prime target — is the … plane:',
      accept: ['control'],
      canon: 'control'
    }
  ];
  function norm(s) {
    return (s || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[-_.,;:!?'"()]/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  }
  function inputs() { return [...root.querySelectorAll('.w056-in')]; }
  function clearMarks() {
    inputs().forEach(i => i.classList.remove('w056-right', 'w056-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w056-msg iw-msg';
  }
  QS.forEach((it, i) => {
    const q = document.createElement('div');
    q.className = 'w056-q';
    const lab = document.createElement('label');
    lab.className = 'w056-label';
    lab.textContent = it.q;
    lab.setAttribute('for', 'w056-in-' + i);
    const inp = document.createElement('input');
    inp.type = 'text';
    inp.id = 'w056-in-' + i;
    inp.className = 'w056-in';
    inp.dataset.k = String(i);
    inp.autocomplete = 'off';
    inp.addEventListener('input', clearMarks);
    q.appendChild(lab); q.appendChild(inp);
    list.appendChild(q);
  });
  root.querySelector('.w056-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, empty = 0;
    inputs().forEach(inp => {
      inp.classList.remove('w056-right', 'w056-wrong');
      const v = norm(inp.value);
      if (!v) { empty++; return; }
      const acc = QS[Number(inp.dataset.k)].accept;
      const hit = acc.some(a => v === a || (' ' + v + ' ').indexOf(' ' + a + ' ') !== -1);
      if (hit) { inp.classList.add('w056-right'); right++; }
      else inp.classList.add('w056-wrong');
    });
    if (right === QS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct — orchestration keeps the moving parts on target.'; msg.className = 'w056-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (empty > 0 && right + empty === QS.length) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going — ' + empty + ' answer(s) still empty.'; msg.className = 'w056-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — ' + right + ' of ' + QS.length + ' answers are right; the red ones need another look at the chapter.'; msg.className = 'w056-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w056-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    inputs().forEach(i => { i.value = ''; });
    clearMarks();
  });
  root.querySelector('.w056-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    inputs().forEach(inp => {
      inp.value = QS[Number(inp.dataset.k)].canon;
      inp.classList.remove('w056-wrong');
      inp.classList.add('w056-right');
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w056-msg iw-msg ok';
  });
})();
</script>
```
